latestVersion.changelog:
Best Shorts Editor — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: edit raw video footage into polished short clips via a cloud-powered AI workflow.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and outputs 1080p MP4 ready for TikTok or YouTube Shorts.
- Automatic cloud connection setup; issues and credits handled transparently.
- Command-based workflow recognizes prompts for edit, export, credits, status, and upload actions.
- Sessions keep your timeline state for efficient iterative editing and batch processing.
